name: Chambers Bay
architects: Robert Trent Jones Jr., with Bruce Charlton (on site) and Jay Blasi (project architect), 2007 (thefriedegg.com)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project WA_PierceCounty_2020_A20 (2020 Lidar: Pierce County, WA, flown 10 Apr - 4 Jun 2020), tile x53y523, clipped to the world + 100 m; requested from the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release chambers-bay-data)

laz.source: 2020 Lidar: Pierce County, WA (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9343), clipped to the course box; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project has no vegetation classes); requested from the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release chambers-bay-data)
laz.label: 2020 USGS lidar

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (917 x 1,301 m, UTM 10N) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (182 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (246 m each side)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 10/2025, Chambers-Bay-Scorecard-10-2.pdf, supplied by the developer in the release chambers-bay-data, 2026-10-20). Every tee row adds up to its printed total. Built from the Blue tees only (COURSE_BUILD 4.1 default).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2020 Pierce County, WA lidar)
Scorecard: Chambers Bay club card (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 10/2025)
notes: Phase 1 (2026-10-20): COURSE_BUILD 4.1 defaults (Blue tees, all water red, OB = OSM boundary, trees from lidar, wind 2-12 mph for the Puget Sound shore). Theme coastal pending the developer's answer (intake question 1).
